name: rocqwash 头注模板库 v1（战役正典蒸馏·金标引据在册·无据不铸）
note: ③头注形洗 --header-map-preset 钦名模板库。占位值全部承目标件自身：{name}＝basename 去 .v；{deps_stdlib}/{deps_dev}＝目标件 Require 语句逐名（From Stdlib→stdlib 列·顶层裸 Require→dev 列·去重保序）；{bundle}/{summary}/{mission}＝既有前导头注区逐字携带（身内容绝不合成——wash/comment_pack.json header_spec『header CONTENT is per-file data, never synthesized』同律）。任一占位绑不上→该件 plan-miss 如实不硬造。应用语义＝comment_sweep --header-map 前导注释区整体替换；preset 源仅对 gate4 头注域硬项（缺字段/无头注/头注非首块/头注超标）施刀·五字段齐件不对齐改写（防人工 curated 面被机械卷改写·诚实账）。装载器 fail-loud：schema 不识/preset 名不识/占位出白名单/variants 无 else 兜底/任一模板行缺 evidence 金标引据→exit 2。

placeholders.bundle: 首行束语身：既有前导头注区 L1『(* ConstructiveWorld-Set -- <身>. *)』内文逐字携带（终句号归模板行）——无 L1 骨架即绑不上→plan-miss。引据：DecBridge6.v:1/LW3Kills.v:1/abl_tail_supply_66.v:1 束语行同骨架异身
placeholders.deps_dev: 本开发 Require 面清单：目标件顶层『Require [Import] A B.』语句逐名去重保序·渲染『[A], [B]』形。引据：ConstructiveWorld-Set @6e805d1 abl_tail_supply_67.v:32-34（Require Import S01_BaseRing./S02_CauchyComplete./UpAblD1_expf_pack.）对照其头注 :15-16『[S01_BaseRing], [S02_CauchyComplete], [UpAblD1_expf_pack]』逐名同
placeholders.deps_stdlib: Stdlib Require 面清单：目标件『From Stdlib Require [Import] A B.』语句逐名去重保序·渲染『[A], [B]』形。引据：ConstructiveWorld-Set @6e805d1 LW3Kills.v:30-32（From Stdlib Require Import QArith Lia Arith ZArith List./QArith_base./QArith.Qabs.）对照其头注 :13-14『Stdlib [QArith.QArith], [Arith.Arith], …』双列同源（人工缀点名为件级 curated·机械转录取面直名）
placeholders.mission: 使命身：既有头注 Mission 字段身（『Mission.』标签行余文＋续行至次字段标签/收注符·内部换行与缩进原样逐字携带）——无 Mission 标签即绑不上→plan-miss。引据：DecBridge6.v:5-14/LW3Kills.v:5-11 正典 Mission 身位
placeholders.name: 模块名：目标件 basename 去 .v。引据：DecBridge6.v:3 题行自名与 :19 References 自名、:28 Build 命令名同一（一名三现）
placeholders.summary: 题行摘要身：既有『(** * <名>: <身>.』题行内文逐字携带（终句号归模板行）——无题行即绑不上→plan-miss。引据：DecBridge6.v:3/LW3Kills.v:3/UpReqConcB1.v:3 题行同骨架异身

      ConstructiveWorld-Main whose statement names are carried over here
      verbatim (statement-face Set-carrier completion).

Constructivity.  All named statements and fields are carried by [Set]
      (decidable Q-carriers and boolean identity carriers); statements
      extract with [Obj.magic] = 0 and no erasure; [coqchk] reports
      [Axioms: none].

Build.  [coqc -native-compiler no -q -Q . "" {name}.v] compiles cleanly
      (exit 0); the artifact starts with [436f7121 000160bc]. *)
